content:
maya: Heads up — our us-west1 reserved GPU commitments for Q1 are showing a bunch of spend attributed to `infra` instead of the product tags. spotted during the weekly billing scrub :thinking_face:

sam: ouch. any idea which reservations? region-level or specific SKUs?

maya: looks like 4 reservations (A100-80g) that were moved to a new nodepool last month. nodepool labels didn't carry so billing export matched reservation -> project -> default tag (infra).

rahul: can you paste the bq query you used? I'll cross-check with GKE node labels.

maya: here — quick filter I ran in billing export:

```sql
SELECT sku_description, project.id, labels.key, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `company_billing.gcp_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE sku_description LIKE '%A100%' AND billing_account_id = '0000-AAAA'
AND usage_start_time >= '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY sku_description, project.id, labels.key
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

ops-bot: billing-alert: High untagged_gpu_cost detected in us-west1 (triggered by maya). See runbook: /ops/runbooks/billing-untagged-gpus.md :eyes:

gina: I dug into the nodepool history — when we drained the old pool and recreated a spot-capable pool we used terraform module v3.4 which dropped `team` and `product` labels on nodes. terraform plan missed it.

paul: So cost is being charged to infra project because labels are missing on VM instances -> billing export has no product tag. We need a reconciliation + a prevention plan.

rahul: Quick mitigation: create a script to map instances to reservation IDs and patch instance labels in GCP (for billing reporting). I can run it if finance signs off on backdating attribution.

finance-bot: finance-notice: any patch to labels affecting historic export requires approval from @finance-team. Please file a ticket with estimated delta.

maya: I'll estimate the delta tonight and open a jira. estimated ~ $18k for the month if fully misattributed.

gina: For prevention: propose 1) admission webhook for our infra-cluster to block nodepool creations without required labels, 2) add a terraform test in CI that asserts nodepool module sets labels, 3) billing alert that compares reservation.owner label vs nodepool.team label.

sam: +1. also add a pre-apply check in the infra repo that scans for label drift on `terraform apply` runs.

paul: Action list:
- maya: open finance ticket with cost delta + attach bq query (due EOD today)
- rahul: write and dry-run instance-label backfill script, post PR for review (due tomorrow noon)
- gina: PR for terraform module and CI test (due Wed)
- sam: implement alert rule in Datadog for reservation-owner != nodepool.team (due Fri)

maya: filing the ticket now. tagging @finance-team and adding cost breakdown.

rahul: sharing test script in #eng-infra-drafts in 30m. uses `gcloud compute instances add-labels` + backfill mapping from `reservations.list`

gina: created a draft terraform test here: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge/456 — still needs review.

paul: good. after backfill and ticket approve, we should run a one-off BigQuery reprocess to reassign exports (if finance allows). If not, we'll run chargeback reconciliation and invoice journals.

maya: noted. thanks all — will triage and update this thread as things progress :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created incident ticket IT-2026-412 for reservation-owner-drift detection automation.
